reason: User requested two readings due to measurement time.
decision_phase: After both readings were received, before threshold candidates were compared on these readings.
quality_criterion: Mean MSE increase <=5% relative to Dense, RGB 0..255, with zero-baseline exception unchanged.
memory_criterion: CSR array bytes strictly less than Dense, then smallest CSR capacity; ties by smaller mean MSE.
limitations: Two readings give limited information about variability.
Read 2 has six all-zero input triplets for distinct reference colors; both calibration values and the input distribution differ between readings.
The provided H40 header predates the newly collected training data and its training seed is not verified.
selection_interpretation: Provisional for these recorded conditions; not a declaration that calibration and absolute color accuracy are satisfactory.
